chapter.title: Dead Air, Live Alibis
chapter.subtitle: An impossible radio voice interrupts the neighborhood every night.
chapter.description: An impossible radio voice interrupts the neighborhood every night.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: Every night at 11:03, my radio whispers “Miss Two Plates.” Nobody calls me that anymore.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: It is the hook on your old intro song.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: That song was for my healing. Not discovery.

scenes.speaker: Sherlock
scenes.text: Who still has the original recording?

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: The voice left six chopped-up words. My chat says it’s a demon.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: Your chat also said the microwave was flirting.

scenes.speaker: Sherlock
scenes.text: The file header says the tape ran backward. Recover the instruction. The room label matters.

puzzle.title: The file plays backward
puzzle.instruction: The six word-splices are backward. Decode them, then build the instruction. The engineer confirms the place is called STUDIO THREE, and the object is a KEY. Nothing is hidden under the whole building.

pieces.label: YEK
pieces.detail: A physical object, not a musical pitch.

pieces.label: OIDUTS
pieces.detail: Part of a two-word room name.

pieces.label: DNIF
pieces.detail: Reverse the characters; this is an instruction.

pieces.label: EERHT
pieces.detail: Part of the same room name.

pieces.label: KS ED
pieces.detail: Spaces are tape damage. Join, then reverse.

pieces.label: W O L E B
pieces.detail: Spaces are tape damage. Join, then reverse.

hints: Remove stray spaces before reversing. The phrase begins FIND KEY.
Read it as FIND KEY / BELOW DESK / STUDIO THREE.
puzzle.solvedText: FIND KEY BELOW DESK, STUDIO THREE. A location we can inspect—not proof of who left the message.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: Studio Three is booked for a live soundcheck battle. Win the booking and we inspect the desk on camera. Lose and chat clips my fear in 4K.

preDialogue.speaker: Watson
preDialogue.text: Round three has one less Motion on both sides. The station’s power limiter is on.

postDialogue.speaker: Watson
postDialogue.text: Key taped under the mixing desk. TRANSMITTER CUPBOARD. Dust around the tape, none under it. This was placed recently.

postDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
postDialogue.text: The demon has a stationery budget.

postDialogue.speaker: Sherlock
postDialogue.text: And a staff key. Narrow your suspect list.

passive.name: Soundcheck Duel
passive.description: Both sides receive 1 less Motion in round three.

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Sherlock
scenes.text: Someone unplugged the archive feed after the whisper played. These labels tell us which socket accepts which signal.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: Read before you plug. Last time Cornball patched it, the weather report started breathing.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: It was humid.

puzzle.title: Do not feed the weather back into itself
puzzle.instruction: Build one signal path from microphone to antenna using all six components. Match socket codes, not similar-looking names. A connection must use the output of one piece and the input of the next.

pieces.label: Recorder
pieces.detail: IN L7 → OUT D4. The label “amplifier” has been crossed out.

pieces.label: Amplifier
pieces.detail: IN R9 → OUT H1. Do not connect microphone-level audio here.

hints: Start at the only piece with no input.
Recorder accepts L7, not R9; the amplifier belongs near the antenna.
puzzle.solvedText: The full recording plays: four voices asking for their credits back. Somebody cut off that ending before airing the whisper.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: The restored tape ends with four volunteers asking for their credits back. Your anniversary edit cut every name but yours.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: The editor said nobody watches credits.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: Apparently the credits watch you.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: All right. That one hurt. Who made the broadcast?

tips: Read the clues, arrange the pieces, and use hints whenever you need them.

scenes.speaker: Sherlock
scenes.text: Four original takes, four room logs. Their background noises overlap. Match the voices to studios before calling this one person’s revenge.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: I am not scared of a committee. I have survived a family reunion T-shirt vote.

puzzle.title: Four rooms, four takes
puzzle.instruction: Place the witnesses under Studios A, B, C, D, left to right. A has a fan; B has a clock; C has rain against glass; D is soundproof. Studio A’s clock had been removed that morning.

pieces.label: Watson
pieces.detail: No ticking in my take. I was not in the silent room or the room with an outside window.

pieces.label: Alice
pieces.detail: Mine was not soundproof. Neither mechanical noise is on my take.

pieces.label: Streamer’s friend
pieces.detail: My take contains no fan, clock, or rain.

pieces.label: Cornball
pieces.detail: My room had a mechanical background sound. Watson had the other mechanical room.

hints: Place the silent take first, then eliminate rooms for Alice.
Watson must be A. Cornball takes the remaining mechanical room, B.
puzzle.solvedText: Every original take has a different room signature. The broadcast combines all four; somebody assembled it after recording.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew reconstructs the answer with you. The story and its rewards continue.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: The four volunteers admit they spliced their takes together. The engineer scheduled 11:03: the exact point where the new edit drops their credits.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: They coordinated a haunting before sending one text?

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: They sent twelve. You reacted to the last one with a flame emoji.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: I thought they were promoting something.

scenes.speaker: Sherlock
scenes.text: They were. Themselves.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: Credits are back in the upload. Tonight’s opening slot is still booked to my battle show. Beat my crew and we use that slot for the uncut tape.

preDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
preDialogue.text: And a real audience. Center closes in round three. Do not let chat coach you.

postDialogue.speaker: Live Streamer
postDialogue.text: Uncut tape is live. Every name on screen, links in the description. I called the volunteers myself.

passive.name: A Fair Share of Air
passive.description: The center district closes to new plays in round three.

tips: Read the district rules before committing your Motion.

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: 11:03. No whisper. Just my old song and four people finally getting paid.

scenes.speaker: Watson
scenes.text: You still keeping “Miss Two Plates”?

scenes.speaker: Live Streamer
scenes.text: Merch drops Friday. They get a cut.

scenes.speaker: Sherlock
scenes.text: Museum on line two. A trophy disappeared in front of a camera.

scenes.speaker: Cornball
scenes.text: Ask if the trophy had unpaid credits.
